subject: copr: Build cop task should not cancel bo ctx (#64845)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff against its parent in `pkg/store/copr`. The change removes `buildCopTasks` mutating/canceling the caller’s `Backoffer` context when `req.MaxExecutionTime>0`, instead applying the timeout when constructing backoffers (`BuildCopIterator` for task building; `chooseBackoffer` for per-region execution) and explicitly canceling derived contexts to avoid leaks; a regression test asserts `buildCopTasks` no longer cancels the input backoffer context. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; this logic remains unchanged there. No Blocker/High issues found in the touched store behavior.
